name: Hebei Huatong Wires and Cables Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hebei Huatong Wires and Cables Group Co., Ltd. is a prominent Chinese enterprise dedicated to the production and distribution of an extensive range of wires and cables within China and globally. Their comprehensive product line includes advanced solutions such as XLPE insulating power cables, capable of handling voltages up to 35kV, alongside standard PVC insulated power cables. The company provides specialized cabling for various demanding applications, including mining operations, general-purpose flexible cables with rubber sheathing, submersible oil pump cables, and conductors for locomotive and vehicle systems. They also offer critical infrastructure cables for marine vessels, offshore platforms, naval applications, and nuclear power stations. Further offerings encompass pre-fabricated branch cables, aerial cables, control cables, and other custom-engineered special cables, as well as motor winding connecting conductors, aluminum stranded conductors, and steel-reinforced aluminum stranded conductors. Founded in 1993 and based in Tangshan, China, Hebei Huatong Wires and Cables Group has established a significant international presence, exporting its products to a wide array of countries including the United States, the Netherlands, Italy, Russia, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Ethiopia, Ghana, Congo, as well as various nations across the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
